notes.title: Demo 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Sufferers,

Patch 1.3 is here with some major changes to the rabbit movement as well as many bug fixes and improvements that include: 

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevents music volume from changing
[*] Added the option to change the bully commentator volume
[*] Balancing changes: increased all the starting resources
[*] Added the ability to fly without jumping (Experimental)
[*] Added the ability to run backward (Experimental)
[*] Added a live map view (Experimental)
[/list]
Keep the feedback coming on everything, especially the experimental features!

notes.title: Demo 1.0 Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hello Sufferers, 

After a couple of alphas and betas, a fully fledged demo of Resuffer is finally here! You can get your hands on a small chunk of the game right now! 

We can't wait for you to try it yourself, and would love to hear your feedback as the game is constantly changing and evolving on its way to Steam Early Access.

notes.title: Join Resuffer beta now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33912498/3a6b8549bd4c073a979738dd7ac6d54c4d591786.jpg[/img]

Hey there! Welcome to Resuffer Steam page, thanks for stopping by. Resuffer is an arcade game designed around precision both in its control and collision system. Your goal is to avoid obstacles by jumping, aerial turns, slow-motion, special abilities and keep going faster until you reach a certain speed that qualifies you to progress to the next level.

Resuffer is coming soon to Steam, but why to wait until then when you can play the open beta right now! All you need to do is join Resuffer Official Discord, and start playing for free!

[url=https://discord.gg/qZESC9F]Resuffer Official Discord Server[/url]
